caveat: This is a single-window case study, not a test-set metric, and it is never averaged into one. The window has 2 receiver(s) with response-removed data against the dataset's minimum of 3, so it was excluded from the built dataset and recorded as `not_fetched` with that reason. The threshold was deliberately NOT lowered to admit it: moving a data-quality threshold after discovering it excludes the headline event is post-hoc tuning. The model here is the already-trained, already-sealed one, applied unchanged.
